newsitem.title: CANADA: Southam says buys 7 Thomson papers.
newsitem.headline: Southam says buys 7 Thomson papers.

text.p: Southam Inc said on Friday it bought seven Atlantic province newspapers from Thomson Corp.

Hollinger Inc, Southam's controlling shareholder, had originally agreed to buy the newspapers from Thomson. They include two Newfoundland dailies -- the Western Star in Corner Brook and the Evening Telegram in St John's -- and three Nova Scotia dailies -- the Cape Breton Post in Sydney, the Evening News in New Glasgow and the Daily News in Truro.
There is also the Guardian, a daily in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island and the weekly Northern Light in Bathurst, New Brunswick.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The newspapers have a combined circulation of about 130,000 and bring Southam's complement of daily newspapers in Canada to 32.
Southam in September bought six dailies and one weekly in Ontario from Hollinger. Again, these newspapers were sold by Thomson to Hollinger orignally.
